post.yt_desc:
Apple keeps about 75 cents of every Services dollar as gross profit, versus about 37 cents on its devices, according to its fiscal 2025 10-K. This video breaks down how Apple makes money: the iPhone's $209.6 billion (about half of sales), Services' $109.2 billion and 75.4% margin, the App Store commission, the roughly $20 billion Google paid Apple in 2022 to be Safari's default, and the $104.7 billion Apple returned through buybacks and dividends. All full-year figures are fiscal 2025 (year ended September 27, 2025). This video was made before Apple reported its fiscal 2026 results, so those are not included.
